idea: Generalise the one-sided L-frame recursion to "corner square plus a two-arm frame of side 1/j". The bottom arm holds j squares of side 1/j and the left arm holds j−1 of them. The remaining (1−1/j)×(1−1/j) square is filled recursively, scaled from best[m], with the table built bottom-up. Evaluate f(n) ≥ (2j−1)/j + (1−1/j)·f(n−2j+1) for all j.
